title: Graph Coloring Game Monotonicity

game.legal_move: color one uncolored vertex properly from a common fixed palette
game.bob_wins: some uncolored vertex has no available color

proved_claims: If 2*|{v: degree(v)>=q}|-1 <= q, Alice wins with q colors.
If every connected component is complete multipartite, a win with k colors implies a win with every q>=k.
For every graph on at most five vertices, a win with k colors implies a win with k+1 colors.
Any counterexample has at least six vertices, k>=2, admits a proper k-coloring, maximum degree at least k+1, and at least floor((k+2)/2)+1 vertices of degree at least k+1.
limitations: No conclusion for arbitrary finite graphs beyond the stated exclusions.
No complete winning-palette formula or least-counterexample claim.
Bounded literature and repository searches are not exhaustive.
No independent audit is claimed in this author package.
